name: NGC 4907 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4907, a barred spiral galaxy in the Coma Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4907-hubble
story: A barred spiral galaxy showing us its face, its arms wound loosely around a central bar of stars. It belongs to the Coma Cluster, a group of over 1,000 galaxies, where Hubble studied how bright spirals are reshaped as they move through the cluster.

claims.text: NGC 4907 is a barred spiral galaxy
NGC 4907 is face-on with loosely wound arms around a central bar
NGC 4907 is part of the Coma Cluster, a group of over 1,000 galaxies
Hubble program 13777 targeted NGC 4907 to document the stages of ram pressure stripping of bright spiral galaxies in the Coma Cluster
